en: Chapter on Mindfulness, 5. The Question Concerning the Ordination by the Blessed One.
"Yes, great king, full ordination is beautiful."
“But, venerable sir, is there an ordination for a Buddha, or is there not?
“Great King, the Blessed One was ordained at the foot of the Bodhi tree together with the attainment of omniscience;
there is no ordination for the Blessed One conferred by others as there is for disciples, Great King. The Blessed One [established] the training rule...”
“He has prescribed it as something not to be transgressed for as long as life lasts.
This was the fifth question concerning the full ordination of the Blessed One.
